name: Diaphragm tension — course reference
name_zh: 橫膈張力放鬆（課程參考）

indication_en: Course frequency pairs for diaphragm tension: 40,284/84,87; 13,91,217,51/84,87 (slide notes movement); 124/100,62,46; 49/33. These are course references, not validated individual outcomes. The user specified four minutes per step, Medium and Alternating (+/-); these settings are absent from the photo.

name: Autonomic follow-up after visceral tension — course reference
name_zh: 內臟張力處理後：自律神經（課程參考）
name_en: Autonomic follow-up after visceral tension (course reference)
indication_zh: 用於記錄內臟張力處理後的神經／交感神經課程配對：40、284／396、562，再以 13、91、217、51／396、562（原投影片註記配合活動）。依課程流程，先評估胸腰椎旋轉、橫膈前後張力與腰大肌／股直肌／闊筋膜張肌，完成橫膈與個別目標器官處理後再進入本組，並重新評估。每步 4 分鐘、Medium、交流 +/- 由使用者指定，原圖片未列這些設定；配對記錄不代表療效已驗證。
indication_en: Course pairs for nerve/sympathetic follow-up after visceral tension work: 40,284/396,562, followed by 13,91,217,51/396,562 (slide notes movement). The course sequence assesses thoracic/lumbar rotation, anterior/posterior diaphragm tension and psoas/rectus femoris/TFL, addresses the diaphragm and individual target organ, then reassesses after this block. The user specified four minutes per step, Medium and Alternating (+/-); these settings are absent from the photo. Pair transcription does not validate clinical outcomes.
source_notes_zh: 只納入神經／交感神經的可辨識配對。18／62、162 是投影片另列的止血段，不自動套用於本自律神經組；49／39…尾數及右欄部分被遮擋，未補猜；「Treat target organ」未列器官 B 值，保留由個案決定。
